description: 333 subjects of mainnet reference NFTs whose 333 user token was never minted (checked on Koios, 2026-10-22). They were in the CIP-68 baseline (cip68_tokens.json) because its generator derived a 333 subject from every reference NFT. Since ADR-022 V2 serves a 333 or 444 subject only when its user token was seen on chain, so each is a 404. minted_as says which user token of the same name exists instead.
